\## Overview

This document describes Script 1 of the ATAC-seq and RNA-seq integration

pipeline. Script 1 annotates all peaks from the six corrected DiffBind

ATAC-seq output files with genomic feature information using ChIPseeker

and the Ensembl v106 EnsDb for Gallus gallus GRCg6a (AnnotationHub

record AH100636). All peaks are annotated regardless of significance ---

downstream scripts apply their own significance filters as needed.

\### Why annotation is needed

The corrected DiffBind output files from Script 0 contain only genomic

coordinates (Chr, Start, End) and statistical values. Annotation adds:

\- The genomic feature category of each peak (promoter, intron, exon,

intergenic etc.)

\- The nearest gene Ensembl ID and gene symbol

\- The distance from each peak to the nearest transcription start site

\- Gene biotype information

This information is essential for integrating ATAC-seq peaks with

RNA-seq gene expression data in Script 2, and for visualising genomic

feature distributions in Scripts 3 and 4.

\### Why AH100636 instead of TxDb.Ggallus.UCSC.galGal6.refGene

Previous versions of this pipeline used

\`TxDb.Ggallus.UCSC.galGal6.refGene\` (UCSC refGene annotation) and

\`org.Gg.eg.db\` for gene annotation. Both use different annotation

sources and versions from the Ensembl v106 reference used for RNA-seq

alignment and quantification. AH100636 is the Ensembl v106 EnsDb for

Gallus gallus GRCg6a --- the exact same annotation version used throughout

the pipeline --- ensuring complete consistency between ATAC-seq peak

annotation and RNA-seq gene identifiers.

\### Chromosome naming note

The \`seqlevelsStyle()\` function for converting between UCSC and Ensembl

chromosome naming styles is not available for Gallus gallus in

GenomeInfoDb --- this is a known package limitation. The mismatch between

UCSC-style chromosome names in the DiffBind files (chr1, chr2...) and

Ensembl-style names in AH100636 (1, 2...) is handled manually: the chr

prefix is stripped before annotation and restored in the output files.

Peaks on unplaced scaffolds (chrUn_NW\_...) are dropped by ChIPseeker

during annotation as they do not match any Ensembl v106 chromosome ---

this is scientifically correct and expected.

\### Columns added by annotation

\| Column \| Description \|

\|\-\--\|\-\--\|

\| annotation \| Genomic feature category (Promoter, Intron, Exon, Intergenic etc.) \|

\| geneChr \| Chromosome of nearest gene \|

\| geneStart \| Start coordinate of nearest gene \|

\| geneEnd \| End coordinate of nearest gene \|

\| geneLength \| Length of nearest gene \|

\| geneStrand \| Strand of nearest gene \|

\| ensembl_gene_id \| Ensembl v106 gene ID of nearest gene \|

\| external_gene_name \| Gene symbol (Ensembl ID used where no symbol exists) \|

\| gene_biotype \| Gene biotype (protein_coding, lncRNA etc.) \|

\| transcriptId \| Ensembl transcript ID \|

\| transcriptBiotype \| Transcript biotype \|

\| distanceToTSS \| Distance in bp to nearest transcription start site \|

\## Results

\### Annotation summary

\| Comparison \| Input peaks \| Annotated peaks \| Dropped \| Coverage \|

\|\-\--\|\-\--\|\-\--\|\-\--\|\-\--\|

\| AM133_vs_AMScr \| 93,678 \| 92,990 \| 688 \| 100% \|

\| AMAll_vs_AMScr \| 92,751 \| 92,162 \| 589 \| 100% \|

\| AM1_206_vs_AMScr \| 95,911 \| 95,536 \| 375 \| 100% \|

\| AM133_vs_AM1_206 \| 79,564 \| 78,838 \| 726 \| 100% \|

\| AM133_vs_AMAll \| 71,670 \| 70,869 \| 801 \| 100% \|

\| AM1_206_vs_AMAll \| 78,038 \| 77,415 \| 623 \| 100% \|

Dropped peaks are those located on unplaced scaffold chromosomes

(chrUn_NW\_...) that do not match any Ensembl v106 chromosome entry.

All annotated peaks (100%) received a gene identifier --- either a

gene symbol where available or an Ensembl gene ID as placeholder.

\### Gene lookup table

The Ensembl v106 EnsDb contains 24,356 genes for Gallus gallus GRCg6a:

\- 13,605 genes with an assigned gene symbol

\- 10,751 genes using Ensembl ID as identifier (no assigned symbol)

\### Warnings

Bioinformatically expected warnings were generated during annotation:

\- \`.merge_two_Seqinfo_objects\` warnings: ChIPseeker notes sequence

level mismatches between the EnsDb and the peak files --- specifically

unplaced scaffold sequences present in the DiffBind files but absent

from Ensembl v106, and random chromosome sequences present in Ensembl

v106 but absent from the DiffBind files. These warnings are expected

and do not affect annotation of peaks on standard chromosomes.
